title: Glowing motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='46' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- ground shadow hint -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='40' ry='4' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='15' fill='#2f3b57'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='8' fill='#4a5a80'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#9ff0ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#e8fbff'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='66' r='15' fill='#2f3b57'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='66' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#7fe3ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='66' r='8' fill='#4a5a80'/>

  <line x1='74' y1='52' x2='68' y2='36' stroke='#8ef7b5' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <line x1='62' y1='34' x2='76' y2='32' stroke='#8ef7b5' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='8' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- body / tank -->
  <path d='M34 44 Q46 38 58 42 L64 50 Q56 54 46 54 L36 52 Z' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <path d='M36 52 L56 54 Q58 58 52 60 L38 58 Q33 55 36 52 Z' fill='#c73f7d'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <path d='M30 46 Q36 42 44 44 L44 50 Q36 52 30 50 Z' fill='#5b6cf0'/>
  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x='44' y='56' width='18' height='10' rx='3' fill='#8ef7b5'/>
  <rect x='48' y='59' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e0ffe8'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <line x1='30' y1='62' x2='16' y2='58' stroke='#b8c6e6' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q22 46 30 46' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ecb' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
